# ayywi

> Lightweight, framework-agnostic, AI-first design system. One CSS class contract for HTML, Vue, Svelte, Angular, server templates — plus typed React components.

Dark-first, monochrome frame with colour coming from content. Tokens are CSS custom properties prefixed --ayy-, classes are prefixed ayy-. Works in any framework; React components and custom elements render the same markup. Themes, density and RTL are attributes on any element.

## Start here

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): everything in one file — rules, tokens, every component's API and examples
- [manifest/components.json](manifest/components.json): the same, as JSON
- [README.md](README.md): install and usage per framework
- [ai/AGENTS.snippet.md](ai/AGENTS.snippet.md): rules to paste into a consuming project's AGENTS.md (or run `npx ayywi init`)
- MCP server: `npx ayywi mcp` (tools: list_components, get_component, search, get_tokens, get_rules, lint)

## Components

### Actions

- [Button](src/components/button/button.meta.json): Triggers an action. Pill-shaped, monochrome primary with a subtle lift on hover.
- [Dropdown menu](src/components/menu/menu.meta.json): List of actions that opens from a button. Native popover + WAI-ARIA menu keyboard model (arrows, Home/End, type-ahead, Esc/Tab).
- [Theme toggle](src/components/theme-toggle/theme-toggle.meta.json): An icon button that opens a menu of every theme (System, Dark, Dark soft, Light, Light gray), applies the choice to the page and remembers it. The moon or sun on the button shows from CSS alone, following the colour scheme, so it's right on first paint.

### Navigation

- [Navbar](src/components/navbar/navbar.meta.json): Sticky site header on translucent glass: brand at the start, links and actions at the end, content centred at page width.
- [App shell](src/components/app-shell/app-shell.meta.json): The frame of a web app: a fixed-width sidebar (brand, navigation, footer) beside a main area, filling the viewport. The two scroll independently. On phones the sidebar either stacks above the content as a single row that scrolls sideways, or — with a top bar — becomes a drawer that a menu button opens.
- [Bottom nav](src/components/bottom-nav/bottom-nav.meta.json): A phone app's tab bar: three to five top-level destinations, each an icon over a short label, pinned to the bottom of the screen within thumb reach and clear of the home indicator.
- [Breadcrumb](src/components/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.meta.json): Trail from the top level down to the current page (Home / Case studies / Oktopost). Plain, or a blurred pill for heroes.
- [Contents](src/components/toc/toc.meta.json): On-page table of contents with a scrollspy: a rail of section links where the one you're reading gets an accent bar. Optional numbers, one level of nesting, sticky beside long content.

### Forms

- [Field](src/components/field/field.meta.json): Form field wrapper: Label + control + hint or error, stacked with consistent spacing.
- [Input](src/components/input/input.meta.json): Single-line text field. Works for every native input type (text, email, search, number, file…).
- [Textarea](src/components/textarea/textarea.meta.json): Multi-line text field. Optional auto-grow and monospace modes.
- [Select](src/components/select/select.meta.json): Styled native <select>. Keeps the OS picker, keyboard handling and form behaviour.
- [Checkbox](src/components/checkbox/checkbox.meta.json): Native checkbox with a drawn box, check mark and indeterminate state.
- [Radio](src/components/radio/radio.meta.json): Native radio buttons with a drawn dot, grouped in a fieldset with a legend.
- [Switch](src/components/switch/switch.meta.json): On/off toggle for a setting that applies immediately. A native checkbox with role="switch".

### Layout

- [Section](src/components/section/section.meta.json): A band of a page with generous vertical rhythm and a header: optional eyebrow (with a section number), a big title and a muted description.
- [Card](src/components/card/card.meta.json): Surface that groups related content. Flat at rest with an inset top highlight; optional lift and pointer-following spotlight.
- [Tabs](src/components/tabs/tabs.meta.json): Segmented pill tabs switching between panels of related content. Full WAI-ARIA tabs keyboard support.
- [Carousel](src/components/carousel/carousel.meta.json): A strip of slides that scrolls sideways and snaps, with previous/next buttons that disable at the ends. Native scrolling: swipe, trackpad and arrow keys work without JS.
- [Separator](src/components/separator/separator.meta.json): A hairline between blocks: full, fading out at both ends (between page sections), or vertical (between inline items).

### Overlays

- [Dialog](src/components/dialog/dialog.meta.json): Modal dialog built on the native <dialog> element: top layer, inert background, focus handling and Esc for free. Centred, or a side modal (drawer, sheet) that slides in from the inline-start or inline-end edge, or a bottom sheet for phones.
- [Popover](src/components/popover/popover.meta.json): Non-modal floating panel anchored to a button. Built on the native popover attribute: top layer, click-outside and Esc to close.
- [Tooltip](src/components/tooltip/tooltip.meta.json): Short hint on hover or keyboard focus. Works with CSS alone; with React Tooltip or <ayy-tooltip> it moves to the top layer (never clipped) and flips at screen edges.

### Feedback

- [Alert](src/components/alert/alert.meta.json): Inline message box with optional icon, title, description and actions.
- [Toast](src/components/toast/toast.meta.json): Short, temporary notification. One framework-free toast() function renders into a shared region in the top layer (visible above dialogs). Pauses while hovered or focused.
- [Progress](src/components/progress/progress.meta.json): Thin progress bar. Determinate (--ayy-value 0–100) or indeterminate.
- [Skeleton](src/components/skeleton/skeleton.meta.json): Placeholder shapes shown while content loads, with a subtle shimmer.

### Data display

- [Badge](src/components/badge/badge.meta.json): Small pill label for status, category or count. Optional pulsing status dot.
- [Avatar](src/components/avatar/avatar.meta.json): Round (or square) picture of a person or workspace, with initials that show when there's no image or it fails to load.
- [Icon](src/components/icon/icon.meta.json): Inline SVG icon from Hugeicons, ayywi's icon library: 6,000+ free Stroke Rounded icons on a 24px grid. It takes the text colour and follows the text size unless you pick one.
- [Icon tile](src/components/icon-tile/icon-tile.meta.json): An app-icon squircle lit from below by the content's accent, with an SVG glyph in that accent. For products, plugins and services.
- [Stat](src/components/stat/stat.meta.json): A headline number in the heading font, with a muted unit beside it and a short label: downloads, views, results.
- [Data list](src/components/data-list/data-list.meta.json): Label / value pairs on a description list: small uppercase labels over their values, stacked or in a wrapping row.
- [Frame](src/components/frame/frame.meta.json): A browser window around a screenshot, video or coded mock-up: a bar with three dots and an optional address, and a long soft shadow.
- [Chat](src/components/chat/chat.meta.json): A conversation: incoming bubbles at the start edge, the reader's own inverted at the end, a typing indicator and quick-reply buttons.
- [Table](src/components/table/table.meta.json): Data table with quiet hairlines, uppercase headers and hover rows. Styles plain table elements under .ayy-table.
